question: Which bill passed in the Lok Sabha in 2022 seeks to convert the National Rail and Transportation Institute, Vadodara (a deemed university) to the Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Universities (Amendment) Bill**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• **The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill** seeks to establish the **Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya in Vadodara, Gujarat** by converting the National Rail and Transportation Institute into a central university.
